summary: Apply word-by-word text animation from DESIGN-SPEC.md to Sage UI
final_report: Applied word-by-word text animation to Sage workspace and home UI per DESIGN-SPEC section 8. Added CSS .word {display:inline-block;opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px);animation:wordIn 350ms var(--ease) forwards} with @keyframes wordIn to 1409-line workspace and 1154-line index. Removed quiz typing width animation (artType/steps) and replaced with word-based reveal via wrapWords. JS helpers: wrapWords(container) splits text nodes by whitespace, wraps each word in <span class="word" style="animation-delay: idx*35ms">, skipping <pre>/<code> and math delimiters ($, \(, \[), respecting reduced_motion (window.matchMedia). animateWords alias and wrapQuizWords for quiz questions. Applied to assistant bubbles only after sanitize_html+renderMd via addMessage bubble query, not during streaming deltas (final message after streaming completes). show_card now calls wrapQuizWords(card) 60ms after visible. Artifact animations verified: msgCascade 700ms stagger 250ms, artifactReveal 500ms, artSlideRight 500ms, artDrawLine 600ms staggered 150ms, artFadeIn 400ms, todo flip 500ms staggered 120ms - all match spec exactly. Reduced-motion disables .word via media query. No breaking changes: markdown, citations, MathJax skipHtmlTags preserved; pre/code blocks excluded; streaming flow untouched except final bubble. Verified with node --check on both inline script blocks (exit 0).
notes: Checked static/sage-*.html: only sage-workspace.html and index.html (home) have message rendering; sage-library/sessions/health/settings lack chat so unchanged. sage-home.html does not exist, index.html used as home equivalent. Quiz typing converted to word-by-word per user request; todo flip kept; mermaid animations verified durations match DESIGN-SPEC.md exactly; cardIn in index updated to 500ms to align with artifactReveal. Dirty working tree contains many unrelated modifications from prior tasks; this job only touched declared files.
